title: test(e2e): live specs find the list's create button by its test id
body:

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X1QBTiid6jzY5s75cQnqNzC)_

Fixes #36251

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感：只改夜间端到端测试里找“新建”按钮的方式，产品界面一个字不动。
- 为什么做：列表的新建按钮现在写成“新建＋对象名”，七个夜间测试还按旧的“新建”两个字找，开场就超时。
- 出错会怎样：只影响夜间测试结果，不影响用户；改回一行即可撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

Seven live e2e specs clicked the list's create button by an exact accessible name: `/^New$/i` in the two the card names, `/^(New|新建)$/i` in five more. Since #36113 the button reads New plus the object's singular name (for example "New Invoice"), so all seven time out before their first step. Each now clicks `getByTestId('object-view-new-button')`, the handle the button already carries (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewHeaderChrome.tsx`) and that `ui/e2e/list-header-narrow-35446.spec.ts` and the app-shell unit tests already read. No product file changes; no test id was added.

Files, one line each:
- `ui/e2e/live/form-view-subforms.spec.ts`, `ui/e2e/live/grid-file-upload.spec.ts` (named by the card)
- `ui/e2e/live/cascading-options.spec.ts`, `field-conditional-rules.spec.ts`, `grid-conditional-rules.spec.ts`, `grid-parent-rules.spec.ts`, `required-when-submit.spec.ts` (same locator, same nightly lane; folded in so the card's second done-when line holds, declared in the claim)

After this change, no live spec under `ui/e2e/live/` names the create button by text (`grep -rn "name: /^(New\|name: /^New" ui/e2e/live` finds nothing). No changeset: the `ui` workspace root is private and `ui/e2e/**` ships in no package (`skip-changeset`).

## Why

A false red in the nightly live lane hides any real failure in the seven specs it guards. A test id does not move when the button's words change, and the button's words now vary per object.

## Tests

Live lane, run locally on the CI-shaped rig (the `Live E2E UI` job's steps): workspace backend on :4010 via `ui/e2e/live/ci/start-backend.sh`, console `vite build` then `vite preview` on :5190, at head `60612f17`.

## Acceptance notes

- The five extra specs were not counted by the card (its grep matched `/^New$/i` only); they break on the same label change and run in the same nightly lane. Folded in as a bounded in-place fix; the claim on the card names them.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `git grep -n "object-view-new-button" -- ui/e2e/live` lists seven lines, and `git grep -nE "name: /\^\(?New" -- ui/e2e/live` lists none. Read first: `ui/e2e/live/form-view-subforms.spec.ts` (the card's first spec).
